tax.text: He said he would have supported the One Big Beautiful Bill because it provided tax cuts and pledged to continue supporting the president’s agenda.
tax.quote: I would have voted for the Big Beautiful Bill, now Law, which has provided the biggest tax cuts in American history. I stand with the President in these efforts and will continue supporting his agenda to unleash the American economy.

schools.text: He strongly agreed that he supports school choice, including vouchers, tax credits, charter schools, private schools, and homeschooling.
schools.quote: I support school choice, including voucher programs, tax credits, charter schools, private schools, and home schools. Strongly Agree

safety.text: He strongly disagreed with redirecting funds from police departments to community programs.
safety.quote: I support redirecting funds from police departments to community programs. Strongly Disagree

immigration.text: He said border security should be followed by prioritizing deportation of undocumented immigrants.
immigration.quote: President Trump has already done a phenomenal job in securing our border, now we must prioritize the deportation of illegal immigrants.

guns.text: He said the federal government should not prevent people from protecting themselves, their families, or their property.
guns.quote: The federal government does not have a place in preventing people from protecting themselves, their families, or their property.

abortion.text: He described himself as pro-life, supported exceptions for rape, incest, and the mother’s life, and said abortion policy should return to the states.
abortion.quote: I share President Trump's position on this issue. I'm pro-life and support exceptions for rape, incest, and life of the mother. I will promote families and a culture of life.

energy.text: He opposed urgent political action on man-made climate change and said he supports continued fossil-fuel and natural-gas use, as well as nuclear development.
energy.quote: I support the continued use of fossil fuels and natural gas. We must also prioritize the development of nuclear energy.

voting.text: He strongly disagreed that people should be able to vote without photo identification.
voting.quote: People should be able to vote without photo identification. Strongly Disagree

trade.text: He called for stopping many of President Trump’s tariffs, saying they raise prices for consumers.
trade.quote: I think Congress should take back its constitutional authority away from this president and stop many of the tariffs that President Donald Trump has put in place

schools.text: He said public schools should be available to all students and opposed cuts to the Department of Education.
schools.quote: A quality public school education should be available to all students in this country, no matter their zip code.

guns.text: At a town hall, he voiced support for red flag laws and reinstating an assault weapons ban.
guns.quote: his support for gun reform, such as red flag laws and reinstating an assault weapons ban.

abortion.text: At a candidate forum, he pledged to protect a woman’s right to choose.
abortion.quote: Copeland pledged to always protect a woman’s right to choose while also addressing AI regulation and data privacy concerns.

health.text: He supports extending health insurance subsidies and expanding Medicare.
health.quote: I am in favor of extending healthcare subsidies to help Americans pay for their insurance premiums. I also want to see more done to cap the costs of certain drugs. I will also work with our state legislature to expand Medicare.
